--- slide 2: October net sales total is 50.0% above September, but September is missing 2 days: per reported day it is up 35.5%
Metric | October 2026 | September 2026 | Change | Change % | Note
Orders | 20 | 15 | +5 | +33.3% | September partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 20.4%
Gross sales | $240.00 | $150.00 | +$90.00 | +60.0% | September partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 44.5%
Refunds | $30.00 | $10.00 | +$20.00 | +200.0% | September partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 171.0%
Net sales | $210.00 | $140.00 | +$70.00 | +50.0% | September partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 35.5%
Average order value | $12.00 | $10.00 | +$2.00 | +20.0% | September partial: 2 days missing
Buyers per active day | 8.0 | 6.5 | +1.5 | +23.1% | September partial: 2 days missing
Ad spend | EUR 180.00 | EUR 150.00 | +EUR 30.00 | +20.0% | September: 2 days missing; per reported day up 8.4%
Return on ad spend | 4.50 | 3.33 | +1.17 | +35.0% | September: 2 days missing; on 1 of 31 days
Search clicks | 20 | 30 | -10 | -33.3% | September: 2 days missing; per reported day down 39.8%
Average position | 6.0 | 6.5 | -0.5 | -7.7% | September: 2 days missing
Source: the store's daily order records.
Ad rows: Meta, in the ad account's currency (EUR), purchases in a 7 day click window. Search rows: Search Console, Pacific time, a lower position is nearer the top.
Change % is the change over September's figure, n/a when that was zero. Buyers per active day is the average of each day's distinct buyers, over days with orders. Average order value is gross sales divided by orders.
Per reported day divides a total by the days with orders plus the days with no orders, so months with different numbers of days with data can be compared.

Top queries and pages add up each day's top rows over 2 days, so a key outside a day's top rows is not counted: they are lower bounds, not totals.
--- slide 8: October refunds total is 200.0% above September, but September is missing 2 days: per reported day it is up 171.0%
Net sales total was $210.00 in October, 50.0% above September ($140.00), but September is missing 2 days: per reported day, net sales are up 35.5% ($6.77 against $5.00).
Orders total was 20 in October, 33.3% above September (15), but September is missing 2 days: per reported day, orders are up 20.4% (0.65 against 0.54).
The biggest move was Refunds, 200.0% above September in total, but September is missing 2 days: per reported day it is up 171.0%.
The best day was Oct 1 with net sales of $150.00.
Ad spend total was EUR 180.00 in October, 20.0% above September (EUR 150.00), but September is missing 2 days of ad data: per reported day, ad spend is up 8.4% (EUR 5.81 against EUR 5.36).
Return on ad spend was 4.50 in October, up 35.0% from September (3.33), and September is missing 2 days of ad data.
Search clicks total was 20 in October, 33.3% below September (30), but September is missing 2 days of search data: per reported day, search clicks are down 39.8% (0.65 against 1.07).
Average position was 6.0 in October, better by 7.7% (nearer the top) from September (6.5), and September is missing 2 days of search data.
Narrative written from the computed figures on the previous slides.
--- slide 9: Data health: every day of October is covered in all 3 sources
Source, October | Days with data | Days with nothing to report | Days with no data | Days that may still change | Stored daily figures used
Store | 2 | 29 | 0 | n/a | 12
Ads | 2 | 29 | 0 | 0 | 8
Search | 2 | 29 | 0 | 0 | 6
Days with no data in October, store: none.
Days with no data in September, store: Sep 10, Sep 11.
Days with no data in October, ads: none.
Days with no data in September, ads: Sep 10, Sep 11.
Days with no data in October, search: none.
Days with no data in September, search: Sep 10, Sep 11.
A month with days missing is understated, so its changes are marked partial.
For each source, days with data, days with nothing to report and days with no data add up to the days in the month.
A day with nothing to report is one where a data pull ran and found none. A day with no data is one no data pull covered. A day that may still change is one close to the report date: purchases and search figures are restated for a few days.
--- provenance (file property, not on a slide): Written by a fixed template from the computed figures (no model key is set). No model was used.
